_about: Where 'open/download someone's Nth latest <thing>' asks look. Add a site by adding a row; no code change. yt-dlp must support the site. 'channel_urls' try {handle} (the name with only letters, digits . _ -); 'search' is yt-dlp's search prefix used when no handle matches. 'format' is what a download saves: video or audio. Put an edited copy in the hub state folder to override this file.
